meta.description: Numeric factual data extracted from Warren Buffett's annual letters for analysis and visualization.
notes: Performance: annual % change in per-share MARKET value of Berkshire vs. S&P 500 (with dividends), 1965-2024. This is the metric Buffett adopted as primary from 2019 onward; earlier years' market-value figures are taken from the same standardized table in recent letters.
Holdings: itemized top common-stock holdings, 2002-2021, in USD millions (shares, cost basis, year-end market value). Berkshire stopped publishing the itemized table after the 2021 letter.
All values are facts extracted from the letters; no letter prose is included.
